title: Bleach Mirrors High Mobile Game Streams 2 New Short Videos
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment revealed two new short videos for the Bleach Mirrors High mobile game on Saturday. The trailers announce that pre-registrations for the game are now open . The game is scheduled for release in 2026.
author: ANN

title: 'Arcanadea' Reveals Main Staff, Additional Cast, Second Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The Arcanadea Engage Fest 2026 event revealed the main staff, four additional cast members, and a second teaser promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Arcanadea model series on Saturday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027 on TV Asahi's NUMAnimation programming block and BS Asahi.
author: MyAnimeList

title: PuniRunes Anime's 4th Season Reveals New Characters in Promo Video
content: The official YouTube channel for Takara Tomy 's PuniRunes toyline began streaming a promotional video on Saturday for the fourth season of its anime series, titled PuniRunes Puni 4 . The staff also announced on the female comedy duo Ganbareruya will voice the new characters Sanrun and Tsukurun in the series.
author: ANN

title: Roji's Ao to Midori Boys-Love Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content: A website opened on Saturday to announce that Roji 's Ao to Midori (Ao and Midori) boys-love manga is getting a live-action television series that will debut on October 5. The series will star Naoya Kusakawa as Midori Yamamura and Hidekazu Chinen as Ao Hayama.
author: ANN
